question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be given and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching is to be given to the worthy.
It is not to be given indiscriminately.
The prohibition extends to just anyone.
inference: This Kaula teaching should be given only to the worthy and not to anyone at all.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy; it should not be given to just anyone.
